latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator by Image.

- Instantly turn 1–3 images into 1080p MP4 videos with AI — no timeline or export settings needed.
- Supports easy uploading of product or landscape photos and simple prompt-based editing (e.g., add background music, transitions).
- Handles session management and free token acquisition automatically (no login required for up to 100 free credits).
- Exports high-quality video compatible with major social media platforms in ~30–60 seconds.
- Includes built-in support for tracking job status, credits, media uploads, and error handling.
- Provides clear feedback, guides, and workflow tips for new users.
